from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
# D4 shape groups; assign nearest unique source instances for each class
ass=[None]*len(ones)
keys={dcanon(canon(c)) for c in ones}
for k in keys:
 ti=[i for i,c in enumerate(ones) if dcanon(canon(c))==k]
 src=[(int(col),cc) for col,cc,sh in objects if dcanon(sh)==k]
 cr=lambda cc: (sum(r for r,c in cc)/len(cc),sum(c for r,c in cc)/len(cc))
 cost=np.array([[abs(cr(ones[i])[0]-cr(cc)[0])+abs(cr(ones[i])[1]-cr(cc)[1]) for col,cc in src] for i in ti])
 rr,cc=linear_sum_assignment(cost)
 for a,b in zip(rr,cc): ass[ti[a]]=src[b][0]
 print(len(k),ti,[(ass[i]) for i in ti],cost[rr,cc])
print('ass',ass)
